definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 clause 3 has no entry for it (3.153 relative item, 3.156 report writer, nothing between), and its meaning in 2023 rests on §2023:13.8.1 and §2023:13.14.1, word-identical to §2002:13.7 and §2002:13.12 (the report section describes the reports to be written to report files; each report begins with an RD entry; 13.18.46.2 is only the REPORT clause format). The rule's term is report file, defined identically (§2002:9.1.19 = §2023:9.1.22) as a sequential output file whose FD carries a REPORT clause; the dropped 'report' definition does not change which files it governs.
